content: Knowledge base holds the reference files available to the agent. Add the documents it needs when you have permission, and keep them relevant to the task.

comment.text: Body of the AI Agents onboarding tour step that highlights the Knowledge base tab (or a file in it) inside an agent. Knowledge base is the UI name of that section and should match its translation.

usage.context:
hasItems &&
 agentHooks &&
 revealStep(
 isStandIn ? KNOWLEDGE_FILE_SELECTOR : KNOWLEDGE_TAB_SELECTOR,
 t("AiAgentsTour:AgentKnowledgeBaseTitle"),
 t("AiAgentsTour:AgentKnowledgeBase"),
 callbacks,
 AI_AGENTS_TOUR_LABEL,
 agentHooks.knowledge,
 isStandIn
 ? [KNOWLEDGE_TAB_SELECTOR]
